subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Is summarized proof enough for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path, or should this PR require visible latest-head terminal output, logs, or an artifact before merge?
rationale: The patch changes persisted-state upgrade behavior and the remaining uncertainty is proof sufficiency and compatibility acceptance, not a narrow code defect that ClawSweeper can repair safely.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Accept Current Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the source inspection, tests, and summarized manual proof as enough for this upgrade path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Out Of Runtime
options.body: Pause this PR and require the legacy no-code cleanup to live in doctor or migration-owned code instead of the runtime stale check.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and has recent ownership of the touched plugin registry/discovery paths.
